description: ESP32-H2-MINI-1-H4S carrier that drops into a Tuya TYWE2L footprint.
notes: The two GPIO namespaces cross over. ESP8285 GPIO12 becomes H2 GPIO14 and ESP8285 GPIO13 becomes H2 GPIO12. A record where esp8285_gpio equals h2_gpio is a red flag, not a reassurance. Validate on leg, which equals the pad number.
Leg order is the physical left-to-right order viewed from the module face, per the TYWE2L datasheet in hardware/datasheets/.
